Not cheating at all — it's one of the most studied, legal supplements out there, used by lifters at every level. It's not going to turn you into someone else overnight, but it can help with training volume and recovery over time.

As for how much: that's a dosing question, and I'll leave the number to a doctor or dietitian. What I'll say is it's typically taken daily and consistency matters more than timing around workouts.
